title: HRV-Longitudinal-Analyzer: Longitudinal Heart Rate Variability Analysis
description:
HRV-Longitudinal-Analyzer is an open scientific software application for organizing, processing and analysing longitudinal heart rate variability (HRV) data obtained from repeated measurements.

Version 2.0.0 provides a public workflow that imports HRV reports exported from Kubios HRV Software, detects participants, organizes repeated measurements, automatically replaces participant identifiers with anonymous labels, and generates standardized scientific outputs.

The software is intended for longitudinal physiological monitoring, exercise science, sports science, clinical research, health monitoring, teaching and reproducible Open Science workflows.

Documentation: https://sportslabresearch.github.io/HRV-Longitudinal-Analyzer/

Source code: https://github.com/SportsLabResearch/HRV-Longitudinal-Analyzer/tree/dev/v2
